blurb: Guests walk through tunnels with sharks, bat rays, and schools of anchovies, touch sea stars, anemones, bat rays, and sharks, and see North American river otters. The aquarium is located at PIER 39 on San Francisco's waterfront. Tickets allow all-day access after redemption.
